page.layout: One page, one column of running text with Hebrew headwords set in the margin-free text, ending with a catchword "T" below the last line. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: tendit vel metata est cœlos, ut Ab. Esra explicat: vel, Palmâ distendit, explanavit & aquavit cœlos, ut essent instar Veli & Expansi.
טִפְחִים m. p. Educationes, quasi Palmationes dicas: עוֹלְלֵי טִפְחִים Parvulos educationum, Thren.2.20. id est, qui manibus adhuc gestantur & educantur; ut R.Salomon explicat.

מִטְפַּחַת f. Ventrale, juxta quosdam, Ruth.3.15. Kimchi in lib. Radic. Peplum exponit, & sic in Majemone, Par.2.fol.27. מִטְפַּחַת שְׁבָרְאשׁ Peplum quod est in capite ejus. Plur. מִטְפָּחוֹת Ventralia, Jef.3.22.

טָפַל Concinnavit, Alluit, Conluit: Praeter. טָפְלוּ עָלַי שֶׁקֶר Concinnant, Connectunt contra me falsitatem, Psal.119.69. Particip. praesens, טֹפְלֵי שֶׁקֶר Concinnatores falsi, Job.13.4. Futur. וַתִּטְפֹּל עַל־עֲוֹנִי Affuis ad iniquitatem meam, Job.14.17.
טִפְסָר m. Imperator, Dux, Princeps: פְּקֻדּוֹ עָלֶיהָ טִפְסָר Constituite super eam Principem, Jer.51 v.27. Plural. cum Pathach, וְטִפְסָרֶיךָ Et Principes tui, Nah.3.v.17.

טַף m. Parvulus, Parvuli, & dicitur tam de maribus, quam foeminis: וּנְשִׁים טַף Parvulos, & feminas, Ezech.9.6. Aff. וְאֵת־כָּל־טַפָּם Omnesq; parvulos ipsorum, Gen.34.29. Hinc Verbum, הָלוֹךְ וָטָפוֹן Euntes & parvulando (ut sic dicam) Jef.3.16. id est, gressibus suis parvulos agendo, ingressu molli, minutis passibus, instar parvulorum, utendo. Et sic Ab. Esra rejectis aliorum interpretationibus, הֲלִכוֹת מַהֲלַךְ טַף Incedentes incessu parvulorum, exponit.
טִפְרֵי Chald. Ungues: Aff. וְטִפְרוֹהִי Et ungues ejus, Dan.4.30. וְטִפְרִיָה Idem; Dan.7.19. Ex Hebraeo טִפְרָא literis s & u pro more communitatis.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are mostly absent in the scan; Hebrew is given in consonantal form where the vowels are not printed. The forms marked by the consonants in the Praeter line of טָפַל and the Chaldee form at the end are uncertain and not checked against the scan closely. The printed "st" ligature in "diftendit" is written as "distendit" under the long-s rule.
